aboutHeading: Red Raptors Demolition in Sunshine West
aboutText: Red Raptors Pty Ltd is a trusted demolition company based in Sunshine West, Melbourne. With extensive experience in commercial, industrial, and residential projects, we have been delivering top-quality demolition services for years. Our team consists of highly skilled professionals who prioritise safety and regulatory adherence, ensuring exceptional results on every project.
servicesText: Red Raptors offers a wide range of demolition services, including commercial, industrial, and residential projects. We handle everything from full demolitions to tight access jobs, ensuring clean and safe site completion.

services.title: Commercial Demolition
services.desc: We specialise in the safe demolition of commercial buildings, minimising disruption to your operations.

services.title: Industrial Demolition
services.desc: Our team manages large-scale industrial demolition with precision and strict safety standards.

services.title: Residential Demolition
services.desc: From full house demolitions to partial removals, we provide efficient services in Sunshine West.

services.title: Tight Access Demolition
services.desc: Expert demolition in hard-to-reach areas, using specialised equipment for safe removal.

services.title: Site Clean & Excavation
services.desc: Thorough post-demolition cleaning and excavation, leaving the site ready for development.

services.title: Specialised Demolition
services.desc: Including fire-damaged structures and school buildings, we tackle unique challenges with skill.
